data.name: El Ministerio del Tiempo VR: Salva el tiempo
data.detailed_description:
"Save the Time" is a virtual reality experience in which you'll be inside one of the best television series in Spain," The Ministry of Time ". In this experience, you​'ll​ live an adventure in first person​,​ try​ing​ to dismantle the plans of the "Angel Exterminator"​ sect​ ​as they tr​y to change the history of Spain and to destroy the Ministry. ​During these 15 minutes, you will face several challenges against time that you will have to solve with ability and cold blood.

The mission will begin in the Archives of the Ministry​ room​, where the director of the Ministry of Time, Salvador Marti, will ​reach out to you​, ​request​ing​ your help. "The Exterminating Angel" has placed a bomb in the doors of the passage of time​ in an attempt to trap in the past one of ​the best agents, Lola Mendieta.

But the trap is more elaborate than ​even ​the Savior himself thought, and both ​of you are trapped. You will have to demonstrate your ​investigative​ and logic abilities​ to escape of the room of the Archives and reach the aisle of the doors. There, with the help of Irene Larra, you will have to cross the gates of time ​to search in the past​ for​ new clues​ about the sect's hiding plac​e.

"Save the Time" is the second virtual experience of the Ministry of Time, ​a ​continuation of "Time in Your Hands", also available on Steam, in which you became an agent of the ministry, after passing an examination with the help of the ​series ​different characters​.​

reviews.review:
UPDATE:

I finished the game.  I dealt with the terrible motion controller setup.  This is an incredibily short VR experience.  But it is well made.  This little game is innovative in a way as it take the puzzle /escape room experience and sets it in a bigger fully-fledged cinematic narrative.  There's something really cool about being inside a TV show.  The cinematic cut scenes were short, but very well made.  You are at the center of this story arc.  You can choose English and everything, including voices, will be in English.  You will be able to tell that the actors voices have been dubbed.

There's only 2 puzzle rooms.  Each room is actually relatively easy for puzzle veterans.  And even if you don't solve the puzzles in time, you'll start off again and this time with a better idea of what you're supposed to do next time.  The annoying part is that several lines repeat themselves, they really need to patch that.  And they need to patch the Oculus Touch control scheme.

I think this game is worth the download.  Quick, easy, fun puzzle/escape room experience with innovative cinematic cut scenes and story.  

Rating 7/10 would work with blonde MILF again in a super-secret time travelling (governmental?) agency saving the world from baddies

So "El Ministerio del Tiempo VR: Salva el Tiempo" is very different from the earlier game they released which was a purely cinematic experience.  This is actually an Escape Room Type game mixed in with cut scenes and there is an English option which has the narrator speaking English.  I did not play this game too much because the movement for the Oculus Rift Touch Controllers is absolutely the worst any game developer can choose for the Touch tracked motion controls.  You have to push the left joystick in to move and press the direction and you have to push the right joystick in and press the direction to turn 90 degrees.  Yikes!

I just gave up after trying to find the items the game wanted with this terrible control scheme.  Hopefully the game developer changes the movement option for Touch controls on the Oculus because it seems like it's a visually well-made Escape room type experience with an actual story involved.  The clues did seem quite obtuse though to finding the right items.  And the narrator keeps repeating lines, which can be annoying.  But I will hold off on reviewing until I can finish the game,  because I am hoping the game gets patched for Oculus w/ Touch.

Rating ?/TBD ... needs to be patched for Touch controls
